title: Patch 8.4: Gruppen-Awareness und Cull-Zahlen (Build 4.3.0-c.6.6.29)
brief_extra: This build changed two things the test looks at closely: when you attack one enemy of a group openly (not hidden), the whole group should take part in that fight; and a cull contract should name one count of foes everywhere (board, slip, front desk).
focus: Patch 8.4: attack one member of a group openly at least once. Does the fight list every member of the group from its start, and do the others act on their own turns?
Patch 8.4: if you manage to stay hidden (sneaking up unseen) before an attack, note whether only the target is taken by surprise.
Patch 8.4: compare the cull count on the board listing, in the contract text on the slip (HUD) and when you turn it in.
